claims.claim: Very clean UK used ps4 with 2 pads
claims.evidence: Witness only reports one PS4 console and one controller; no readable UK/region label or evidence of two controllers.
Witness shows tall dark rectangular items behind the console (possibly cases/accessories) but does not show specific accessories like HDMI/power/charging cables.
Witness does not show readable game titles/discs; only mentions two tall dark rectangular items with no legible labels.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/version (original/Pro/Slim) and region/UK variant not confirmed; pricing varies by model and condition.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console model label (CUH number) and any region/serial sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case common model/unknown variant and treat as unverified region.

risks.risk: Storage capacity (HDD size) and whether it’s upgraded not confirmed.
risks.proof: A photo of the Settings > Storage screen (or system info) showing HDD capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown storage (worst-case) until capacity is shown.

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (disc drive, HDMI output, Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth, USB ports, audio).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the PS4 powering on to the home screen, HDMI display working, and at least one USB port and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst-case) until it boots and connects.

risks.risk: Controller condition not confirmed (stick drift, button responsiveness, charging/battery health).
risks.proof: A video clip of both controllers (if claimed) showing responsive button presses and analog stick movement without drift; also show charging/charging indicator if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller(s) may need service/repair (worst-case) until responsiveness is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Included items not confirmed (power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable, box/manuals).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item with cables and accessories clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (worst-case) until all accessories are shown.

risks.risk: Games/discs count and licensing not confirmed; FC24 inclusion not verifiable from the witness report.
risks.proof: Clear photos of each game case/disc with readable titles (including FC24) or a screenshot showing the game library/account details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no confirmed games included (worst-case) until titles/count are proven.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition not confirmed (scratches, dents, missing covers/labels).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console exterior (front/top/sides/back) and controller surfaces showing wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price at a conservative cosmetic condition (worst-case) until wear is clearly shown.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the PS4 model label showing the CUH number and any region/serial sticker.
Send a photo of Settings > Storage (or System Information) showing HDD capacity.
Send a short video of the PS4 booting to the home screen with HDMI working, plus a quick check of USB ports and Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth.
Send a video showing controller responsiveness (buttons + both analog sticks) and charging/battery status; confirm whether there are 2 controllers.
Send a laid-out photo of all included accessories/cables (power, HDMI, controller charging cable) and any box/manuals.
Send clear photos of all game cases/discs with readable titles (confirm the count and FC24).
Send close-up photos of cosmetic condition on console and controllers (front/top/sides/back).
response.reason: The witness confirms a PS4 console and one controller, but key details that determine a safe Lagos resale price (exact model, storage, full functionality, controller count/condition, and included games/accessories) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed before pricing.
